faq.a1: We are an independent insurance agency based in El Paso, Texas, licensed in Texas and New Mexico. Independent means we do not work for one company — we shop the carriers we represent and bring you the options.
faq.q2: Can I buy a policy right here on the website?
faq.a2: Not quite — and that’s intentional. You can start your quote online and see your options, but before you buy, one of our licensed agents reviews your quote to make sure you’re getting the best option available. Online quotes can sometimes miss additional discounts or savings you may qualify for. Once we’ve reviewed everything with you and you’re happy with your coverage and price, we can activate your policy.
faq.q3: Are the prices I see online final?
faq.a3: They’re a great starting point — and your final price could be even better. Before you decide, we run the required verifications and one of our licensed agents personally reviews your quote to make sure everything is accurate and all eligible discounts and savings have been applied. Then, we’ll confirm the final price with you, walk you through your options, and make sure you’re getting the right coverage at the best price available to you.
faq.q4: Which insurance companies do you shop?
faq.a4: Progressive, GEICO, Root, Lemonade, GAINSCO and more. Carrier availability and eligibility vary by state, by product and by applicant — not every company writes every risk, and the right one for you is whichever comes back best on the day we shop it.
faq.q5: What can you insure for me?
faq.a5: From your car to your home, business, and more — we’ve got you covered. We offer auto, homeowners, renters, mobile home, commercial, work truck insurance, and more. Need more than one type of coverage? We can help bring it all together and look for every opportunity to save.
faq.q6: Do you write SR-22 and high-risk policies?
faq.a6: Yes. Tickets, accidents, a lapse in coverage or an SR-22 requirement are all things we work with regularly. Tell your agent up front so they shop the right carriers the first time.
faq.a7: Sí. Todo el equipo es bilingüe. Puedes cotizar, preguntar y resolver en español, por teléfono o por mensaje, con una persona de verdad aquí en El Paso.
faq.q8: Does it cost anything to get a quote?
faq.a8: No. Quoting is free and there is no obligation. If nothing we find fits you better than what you have, we will tell you that.
faq.q9: How soon can my coverage start?
faq.a9: Most quotes come back the same day. When coverage actually starts depends on the carrier and on what they need from you — your agent tells you exactly what is missing and how soon it can be active.
